dog.description_text:
At just five months old and 13 pounds, this playful and energetic little girl is full of curiosity and personality! She’s happy, healthy, and loves meeting all types of people and making new friends.

She’s been doing really well with potty training and has quickly picked up the routine of going outside during her first walk. She’s still learning and may need a little guidance as she continues to develop those good habits.

She’s curious, social, and sweet with no signs of aggression or excessive barking. She loves to play, explore, and be part of the action, making her a fun and engaging guest to have around!

She is an absolute quick learner and so eager to please!

Within just one day at her new foster home, she mastered "sit," and by day four, she learned "paw" and started consistently using her potty pads.

She’s also conquered her fear of elevators and can now confidently walk up and down stairs.

She is incredibly smart, sweet, and picks up new routines almost instantly!
dog.name: Younger
